## Problem (`#context`)

**H2:** Interruptions have a cost.  

**Lede:** Unreliable supply is not only inconvenient. It stops work, raises running costs, stresses equipment, and makes it harder for a home or operation to stay running.

| Label | Copy |
|-------|------|
| Homes | Essential loads need to stay available — lighting, refrigeration, communications, safety. |
| Businesses and facilities | Operating hours they can plan around, not improvise around. |
| Developments | Electrical infrastructure that can accept today’s system and tomorrow’s expansion. |

## Services (`#solutions`)

**Eyebrow:** What we provide  

**H2:** Power systems, specified as a whole.  

**Lede:** Equipment only performs if it is sized, matched and installed as one system. Takeshi specifies around load, backup duration, site conditions and budget.

### Service names and bodies (order locked)

**01 Energy assessment and system design**  
Site inspection and load evaluation before equipment is recommended. We account for essential appliances and machinery, operating hours, peak demand, backup duration, expansion, site conditions and budget. That determines inverter capacity, storage, generation, protection and supporting electrical work.

**02 Solar-power solutions**  
Supply and installation for homes, offices, commercial sites and institutions — from essential-load backup to hybrid systems that reduce grid and generator use. Panels, inverters, controllers and protection are matched as one design.

**03 Inverter and battery systems**  
New systems, battery replacement, capacity upgrades, fault diagnosis and performance improvement. Capacity follows expected load and required backup time — not a standard kit.

**04 Electrical installation**  
Residential and commercial wiring: new buildings, upgrades, and the work solar and backup systems need. Coordinating this during construction reduces rewiring, improves safety and prepares the property for current or later power systems.

**05 Hybrid and backup-power systems**  
For continuity beyond a simple backup. Configurations may combine grid, solar, batteries, inverters and generators, based on which loads are critical and how much interruption the operation can tolerate.

**06 Estate and multi-unit installations**  
For developers, housing schemes and estate managers: development-wide assessment, standard system options, bulk procurement, phased installation and structured maintenance across units.

**07 Maintenance and after-sales support**  
Inspections, panel cleaning, battery-health checks, connection tightening, wiring review, inverter diagnostics, performance testing and fault resolution. Plans follow the equipment, the site, how hard it is used, and what failure would cost.

### Equipment positioning

**H3:** Specified for the system, not the showroom.  

**Body:** We have experience supplying and installing Deye, Growatt, Felicity, Choice and Sukhig equipment, and other suitable products when they fit the design and are available. Compatibility, performance, safety and supportability decide the selection. A brand name is not a substitute for correct design.

## Philosophy (`#approach`)

**Eyebrow:** How we think  

**H2:** We start with the load, not the equipment.  

**Lede:** The right system is the one designed for how you actually use power. Good equipment still needs that design, plus correct installation, commissioning and support.

| Step | Title | Copy |
|------|-------|------|
| 01 | Understand the load | What must run, for how long, and at what peak. |
| 02 | Design the system | Capacity, storage, generation and protection around that requirement. |
| 03 | Match components | So parts work as one system, not a pile of products. |
| 04 | Install correctly | Electrical work included, not treated as an afterthought. |
| 05 | Test and commission | Prove the system against the intended loads before handover. |
| 06 | Support | Monitoring, maintenance and fault resolution after the power comes on. |

**Experience line:** More than ten years of hands-on industry work across:  

**Capability chips:** load calculation · system sizing · installation · electrical wiring · component matching · troubleshooting · commissioning · after-sales support

## Audiences (`#serve`)

**H2:** Built for how the property actually runs.  

**Lede:** We work with people responsible for a home, a site, or a development — anywhere unreliable supply affects daily life or operations.

| Name | Copy |
|------|------|
| Residential | Homes and residential managers who need dependable backup and a system they can understand. |
| Commercial | Businesses that need continuity, predictable running costs and equipment that stays up. |
| Estates and developments | Multi-unit work: coordinated design, installation and maintenance. |
| Healthcare | Facilities where critical equipment and refrigeration cannot sit on guesswork. |
| Fuel stations | Pumps, payment systems and customer service that depend on stable supply. |
| Offices and retail | Workplaces and shops that need the working day to hold. |
| Hospitality | Guest-facing operations that cannot absorb long interruptions. |

## Customer journey (`#process`)

**H2:** From first conversation to ongoing support.  

**Lede:** If we work together, this is the path — from the first conversation through support after handover.

| Stage | Copy |
|-------|------|
| Understand | The property, the present supply problems, and the outcome you need. |
| Assess | Site and load when the requirement is not already clear. |
| Design | A recommendation: capacity, installation scope, commercial terms, exclusions, maintenance options. |
| Install | Procurement, installation, testing and commissioning. |
| Support | Handover on safe use and limits, then warranty, service plan or maintenance as agreed. |

**H2:** Accountable after the power comes on.  

**Body:** We do not build a reputation by selling the most equipment. We build it by designing the right system, installing it properly, and remaining responsible after commissioning — through handover, maintenance and fault support.

## Contact (`#contact`)

**Eyebrow:** Contact  

**H2:** Tell us what the property needs to do.  

**Lede:** We will determine what the power system needs to support it. Share the property type, which loads must stay on, and how long you need backup. Residential and commercial enquiries use the same starting point.

No phone, WhatsApp, email, or address is part of v1.0. Adding channels requires verified human input **and** a copy revision (v1.1+), not silent invention.
